added_models.model: Population PK/PD (free C5, LDH) model-based simulation of Phase 1/2 data (ravulizumab)

dose.confidence_note: Bundle text of the FDA multidisciplinary review; EOP2 meeting dated 18 Jul 2016 in the same review.
dose.note: End-of-Phase-2 PopPK/PD simulations set a Ctrough >175 µg/mL target and a weight-based q8w regimen before Phase 3.
dose.quote: The Phase 3 body weight‐based dosing regimen was determined based on modeling and simulation analyses of data at the end of Phase 2.

dose.magnitude_basis: free C5 < 0.5 µg/mL sustained over the dosing interval vs model target
dose.confidence_note: Bundle text; quote is a contiguous excerpt of a longer sentence.
dose.note: The model-chosen regimen kept free C5 below 0.5 µg/mL from the first dose through 26 weeks in both Phase 3 trials.
dose.short: Simulated regimen held target in Phase 3
dose.quote: Following the proposed weight‐based ravulizumab dosing regimen, complete inhibition of serum free C5 levels < 0.5 µg/mL (correlated with inhibition of intravascular hemolysis and LDH lowering) was observed by the end of the first dose
dose.reason: Model-chosen regimen reached target in Phase 3
dose.judgement: In-silico model fitted to human Phase 1/2 data, run before Phase 3, so prospective, not a retrodiction. The review states the model's target and the Phase 3 result together (comparison_stated true). Efficacy is scored on the main strip, so this track is dose only.

added_models.model: Population PK and drug-target-drug-complex model simulations for Phase 3 dose selection (crovalimab)

dose.confidence_note: Bundle text of the FDA integrated review.
dose.note: Roche brought PopPK and DTDC model simulations to an FDA Model-Informed Drug Development meeting to pick Phase 3 naive and switch dosing.
dose.quote: A Model Informed Drug Development meeting request was submitted on March 14, 2019, and subsequently granted, to obtain feedback from the Agency on the modeling approach to support crovalimab dose selection

dose.magnitude_basis: share of patients above 100 µg/mL throughout: ~92% simulated vs 93.6% observed
dose.confidence_note: Europe PMC full text (PMC12035591). The simulated 92.8%/91.4% shown in the paper come from the final model; the pre-Phase 3 simulation figures were not seen.
dose.note: Simulations expected ~92% of patients above the 100 µg/mL threshold throughout; in COMMODORE 1-3, 93.6% stayed above it from the first dose.
dose.short: Predicted and observed share above threshold match
dose.quote: PK data demonstrated that crovalimab concentrations were above 100 μg/mL from the first IV loading dose and remained above this threshold throughout the assessment period
dose.reason: Phase 3 exposures matched simulated target attainment
dose.judgement: Paired by me: the paper reports the Phase-3-planning simulations ('Simulations were conducted to confirm the adequacy of the dose and dosing regimen ... for the Phase III studies') and the observed attainment, but does not set the pre-trial prediction against the result. Kept apart from the draft's cyno-c5-pkpd track, which scored the same 100 µg/mL target from COMPOSER.

added_models.model: In-vitro hemolysis assay with recombinant C5 R885H variant (picks eculizumab-resistant genotype patients)

engagement.confidence_note: Same sentence the checker verified verbatim for the draft's engagement opener.
engagement.note: Crovalimab neutralized the R885H C5 variant that eculizumab cannot; predicts R885H carriers would respond to crovalimab.
engagement.short: Variant assay predicts R885H carriers respond
engagement.quote: Consistent with previous reports, eculizumab was unable to neutralize the activity of C5 R885H, whereas SKY59 neutralized this C5 variant with a similar dose-response compared to C5 WT

engagement.magnitude_basis: complete terminal complement inhibition in R885H carriers
engagement.confidence_note: Wiley full text and the ASH 2018/2020 abstracts returned 403 and the letter has no PubMed abstract; the quote is the publisher-page excerpt surfaced by web search and needs checking against the full text. Earlier public form: ASH 2018 abstract (Blood 132 suppl).
engagement.note: All four R885H carriers in COMPOSER had complete terminal complement inhibition and haemolysis control on crovalimab; one of six in COMMODORE 1 later stopped for lack of efficacy.
engagement.quote: with crovalimab treatment, all four patients achieved sustained terminal complement inhibition and haemolysis control consistent with all patients in COMPOSER
engagement.judgement: Patient-level prediction: the assay says which genotype responds. Paired by me with the COMPOSER subanalysis (comparison_stated false). The FDA 2024 review notes one of six COMMODORE 1 C5-polymorphism patients discontinued for lack of efficacy after week 24, without genotype-level hemolysis data, so I keep same but flag it. Year may move to 2018 if the ASH abstract is quotable.

considered_not_added: Ravulizumab C5 variant binding/hemolysis assays (W917S, K879/K882/R885 epitope; FDA 761108): no patient comparison of the variant predictions for a member drug beyond eculizumab's known R885H failure (eculizumab is not a member).
Pozelimab PopPK (Lin 2024) and BLA 761339: CHAPLE disease, not PNH; pozelimab+cemdisiran ACCESS-1 includes an siRNA and was not paired with any model here.
Tesidolumab (LFG316): no model-to-patient comparison found; development stopped for strategy.

In-vitro C3-opsonization / extravascular hemolysis and strong-activation residual C5 activity models (Risitano 2009, Harder 2017): built and compared on eculizumab (non-member); no member-specific comparison found in the budget.
Model-informed precision dosing of crovalimab (Ter Avest 2026, in silico): retrospective dosing-individualization study with no prospective patient comparison.

Crovalimab C5-polymorphism cohort of COMMODORE 1 (FDA 761388): cohort-level efficacy not reported in the review beyond one discontinuation for lack of efficacy; used as a flag in the R885H entry, not as its own entry.

Pozelimab + cemdisiran NHP PK/PD (PMC9202903, 2022) vs Phase 2 NCT04811716 / ACCESS-1 NCT05133531: every patient arm pairs pozelimab with cemdisiran, a non-member siRNA; patient_trials at most, no status change (checker).

gaps.lead: COMMODORE 1 C5-polymorphism cohort: one discontinuation for lack of efficacy (FDA 761388)
gaps.detail: Changes nothing scored. FDA 761388 IntegratedR (bundle text) reports only that in the C5 polymorphism cohort (n=6, polymorphisms not broken down by genotype) 'one subject discontinued the study treatment on or after 24 weeks of treatment due to lack of efficacy'; no genotype, free C5, terminal complement or LDH data per subject. Not attributable to an R885H carrier or to failed C5 neutralization, so it cannot contradict engagement #4 (c5-r885h-variant-hemolysis-assay, 2022 same), whose note already records it. Re-searched (fc.py search; PMC11760285 review): no publication gives the cohort's genotype-level outcomes.
